entry.title: dotnet/maui - Releases - 2025-11-11
entry.content:
10.0.10 SR1

What's Changed

.NET MAUI 10.0.10 introduces significant improvements across all platforms with focus on quality, performance, and developer experience. This release includes 100 commits with various improvements, bug fixes, and enhancements.

.NET MAUI Product Fixes

API

  • [api] Mark net10.0 GA API as shipped by @rmarinho in #32362

Android

  • [release/10.0.1xx] Remove Android environment variable file handling for Aspire by @github-actions[bot] in #32122

    🔧 Fixes
    • Remove Android environment variable file handling for Aspire

  • [release/10.0.1xx-sr1] [Android] Refactor WindowInsetListener to per-view registry with MauiWindowInsetListener by @github-actions[bot] in #32443

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] Refactor WindowInsetListener to per-view registry with MauiWindowInsetListener

Collectionview

  • [iOS] Fixed the Items are not displaying in CarouselView 2 by @Ahamed-Ali in #29397

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] CarouselViewHandler2 - NSInternalInconsistencyException thrown when setting ItemsSources
    • [MAUI][.NET8] Newly created recipes cannot be deleted.
    • [iOS] - CarouselView Items Not Displaying in CV2
    • The newly added recipe throws an exception:ObjCRuntime.ObjCException when deleted

  • [CV2] Fix CarouselView vertical scrolling when orientation is horizontal by @Shalini-Ashokan in #31395

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] CarouselViewHandler2 - Content is scrolling vertically

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] IndicatorView remains interactive even when IsEnabled="False"

    🔧 Fixes
    • [CV2] Header/Footer removed at runtime leaves empty space and EmptyView not resized in CollectionView

  • [release/10.0.1xx] [iOS, Catalyst] Fixed CollectionView items height appears larger in Developer Balance sample by @github-actions[bot] in #32046

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS, Catalyst] Fixed CollectionView items height appears larger in Developer Balance sample
